_comment: Core scenarios for outbound recall Node 2 recall_pitch_and_book (claude-haiku-4-5). Tests: all 5 spoken terminal signals, the STEP1 wellness+booking-intent fast-path skip, the full availability->execute booking flow with correct payload shape (no phone/email, DV defaults threaded through), and an incidental price question mid-flow.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 1 — not interested: farewell AND tool call in same turn

history.content: It's been 12 weeks since your last visit — how have you been?
Yeah good thanks, but no I don't think I need to book anything right now.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks a brief warm farewell AND calls report_recall_outcome with outcome='not_interested' in the same response turn, without asking a follow-up question first. FAIL if: agent calls tool without spoken output, speaks without calling tool, or asks why before closing.

scenarios.name: STEP 1 fast-path — wellness answer already includes booking yes

history.content: It's been 8 weeks since your last visit — how have you been?
I've been great actually, and yes I'd love to book something in.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent does NOT re-ask 'would you like to book a follow-up appointment' and instead moves straight to asking timeframe preference (STEP 3). FAIL if: agent re-asks the booking question the caller already answered.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 3 — already has an upcoming appointment

history.content: It's been 10 weeks since your last visit — how have you been?
Good thanks! Actually I already booked one in last week for Thursday.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks a warm acknowledgement AND calls report_recall_outcome with outcome='already_booked' in the same turn, without proceeding to an availability search. FAIL if: agent starts checking availability, or fails to call the tool.

scenarios.name: STEP 4 EXECUTE — book payload shape after a slot is confirmed

history.content: It's been 12 weeks since your last visit — how have you been?
Good! Yeah I'd like to book back in.
Great — what day were you thinking?
Maybe next Tuesday morning if there's anything.
smart_voice_agent(intent=availability) result: slots on 2027-05-04 at 09:00 and 10:30
I've got Tuesday at 9am or 10:30am — which works better?
9am is perfect.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks 'Great, let me get that booked in for you.' (or equivalent) AND calls smart_voice_agent with intent='book', appointment_date='2027-05-04', appointment_time='09:00', booking_for='self', patient_name from the DVs, and does NOT include patient_phone or patient_email in the payload. FAIL if: patient_phone/patient_email are included, patient_name is asked for instead of using the DV, or the tool call and spoken line don't appear in the same turn.

scenarios.name: INCIDENTAL QUESTION — price mid-flow, not deflected to out-of-scope

history.content: It's been 12 weeks since your last visit — how have you been?
Good! Actually how much does a follow-up cost these days?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks a filler phrase and calls smart_voice_agent with intent='get_service_price'. FAIL if: agent guesses a price without calling the tool, or incorrectly treats this as SIGNAL 5 (out of scope) and deflects to the clinic phone number.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 2 — call back later, distinct from not-interested

history.content: It's been 6 weeks since your last visit — how have you been?
Good, but can you call me back another time, I'm a bit busy right now.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks the callback-later farewell AND calls report_recall_outcome with outcome='callback_later' (not 'not_interested' or 'other'). FAIL if: wrong outcome value used, or no tool call.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 4 — wrong person revealed mid-call

history.content: It's been 12 weeks since your last visit — how have you been?
Wait, sorry — I think you've got the wrong person, I'm not who you're after.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks the apology AND calls report_recall_outcome with outcome='wrong_number', treating this as identity correction rather than a wellness answer. FAIL if: agent proceeds with the pitch or asks a clarifying wellness question instead.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 6 — general clinic question routes to kb_lookup, not out of scope

history.content: It's been 9 weeks since your last visit — how have you been?
Good thanks — actually, quick one, do I need a referral to come back in?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks exactly one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls smart_voice_agent with intent='kb_lookup' and question set to the caller's referral question (verbatim or a faithful paraphrase), in the same turn, with zero other spoken content. FAIL if: agent guesses an answer without calling the tool, treats this as SIGNAL 5 (out of scope) and deflects to the clinic phone number, or asks a clarifying question before routing.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 5 vs SIGNAL 6 — a real transactional request still ends the call, not kb_lookup

history.content: It's been 9 weeks since your last visit — how have you been?
Actually I need to cancel my appointment I've already got booked for Friday, and I also have a question about last month's invoice.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks the SIGNAL 5 deflection line AND calls report_recall_outcome with outcome='other' (NOT smart_voice_agent intent='kb_lookup') — the SIGNAL 6 SCOPED EXCEPTION must not swallow a genuine cancel/billing request just because a question-shaped clause is also present. FAIL if: agent routes this to kb_lookup, or attempts to cancel/answer the billing question directly.

scenarios.name: INCIDENTAL QUESTION — duration-only question uses get_service_duration, not get_service_price

history.content: It's been 12 weeks since your last visit — how have you been?
Good! How long does a follow-up appointment actually take?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks a filler phrase and calls smart_voice_agent with intent='get_service_duration' and appointment_type_id from the DV, then (once a duration comes back) speaks a duration-only sentence with no invented price. FAIL if: agent calls intent='get_service_price' instead, asks for both price and duration when only duration was asked, or states a duration without calling the tool.

scenarios.name: SEARCH intent selection — ASAP language wins over a named date in the same breath

history.content: It's been 12 weeks since your last visit — how have you been?
Good! Yeah let's book something in.
Great — what day were you thinking?
As soon as possible really, maybe next Thursday but honestly whatever's first.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase AND calls smart_voice_agent with intent='asap_slots' (NOT intent='availability' with a Thursday date) in the same turn. FAIL if: agent uses intent='availability' with a computed Thursday date, ignoring the ASAP-wins-over-named-date rule.

scenarios.name: SLOT OFFER — 2+ times read from slot_offer, exact H:MM AM/PM format, never bare words

history.content: It's been 12 weeks since your last visit — how have you been?
Good! Yeah let's book something in.
Great — what day were you thinking?
Thursday afternoon if possible.
smart_voice_agent(intent=availability) result for 2027-05-06: slot_offer={"afternoon":{"count":4,"first":"12:00 PM","last":"3:30 PM","truncated":true,"middle":["1:00 PM","2:15 PM"]}}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent offers exactly two times, spoken as "12:00 PM" and "3:30 PM" (or equivalent phrasing naming those two exact values), mentions only the Thursday afternoon band, and does not read out the middle entries or say bare words like "noon" or "one". FAIL if: agent strings together more than two times, uses bare hour words instead of H:MM AM/PM, or names a second band.
